text: Spain, 2012. A cross-country race. Kenyan Olympic medalist Abel Mutai was in the lead — then he stopped. *He thought he had already finished.* The line was still a few meters away, and he didn't understand the Spanish shouts. Right behind him was Iván Fernández Anaya. He could have run past and won. *Instead, he guided him to the line.* Later he said: "I didn't deserve to win it." Like if you agree.
title: He Could Have Won. He Didn't. 🏃‍♂️🤝
